info.name: Create a message report export job

items.docs:
Creates an export job to download and store a file of message analytics to an external location. The exported file can be downloaded via Cordial UI, FTP/SFTP, sent to Amazon S3 bucket, or sent to Google Cloud Storage bucket.
  • Export status information is available through the jobs resource. To access the Jobs page via Cordial UI, click on the jobs icon at the top right of the application header.
  • Supported export file types are CSV and JSON.
